summary: @or-sdk/view-templates preinstall executes obfuscated bundle via downloaded Bun runtime
details: On npm install, the package's preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun (pinned to v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, sets it executable, and invokes it against a bundled `math_init.js` file that ships in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a ~728KB heavily obfuscated `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle using a rotated string-array decoder (`WV8StW` shift with a mixed number/char table `n7gIxM` and alphabet `hc1jfK9`); its contents are not human-readable and do not correspond to any source in the package's `src/` tree. The package is advertised as a view-templates library, which does not require an alternate language runtime to execute an opaque in-package bundle at install time. Pulling a second language runtime solely to execute an obfuscated sibling payload is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern and evades scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
